svg.title: Before: one PostgreSQL server
svg.desc: Devices connect over MQTT, HTTP, CoAP and LwM2M transports to ThingsBoard. Telemetry history goes to Cassandra at normal load, while every attribute and latest-value update funnels into one PostgreSQL server, which runs hot with its write capacity saturated.
svg.text: Telemetry history spreads across Cassandra nodes, while every latest-value update lands on one machine
telemetry history · every message appends a new row
attributes & latest values · every message overwrites a row
